verdict.rationale: Mailgun documents public APIs to send, receive, and track email. The docs include an API reference with a regional API overview, API key authentication including scoped Domain Sending Keys, Postman collections of all APIs, and multi-language SDKs, and a developer independently reports it is 'incredibly easy to integrate with'. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes of common openapi/swagger paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Powerful APIs that enable you to send, receive, and track email effortlessly
Import all Mailgun APIs into Postman for easy testing and integration. Our public workspace includes organized collections with examples, environment variables, and ready-to-use requests.
Domain Sending Keys are API keys that only allow sending messages via a POST call on /messages and /messages.mime endpoints for the domain in which they are created for.
As a developer it's incredibly easy to integrate with
